cards.quote: Sequencing DNA means determining the order of the four chemical building blocks - called "bases" - that make up the DNA molecule.
cards.stem: What process identifies the sequence of chemical units in DNA?

cards.quote: In the DNA double helix, the four chemical bases always bond with the same partner to form "base pairs."
cards.stem: What name is given to the chemical units that form DNA?

cards.quote: The sequence tells scientists the kind of genetic information that is carried in a particular DNA segment.
cards.stem: What do scientists learn from the order of DNA units?
